text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While out shopping, as I happened to pass by a takoyaki stand...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Hey you, yes, you over there!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, aren't you feeling a little peckish?
You're so hungry you can't even think straight... right?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
For someone like you, takoyaki is the perfect match!
These treats grilled with bamboo needle expertise will bring total reliiief☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She skillfully flipped the takoyaki,
filling the air with a mouthwatering aroma.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Time it just right, and poke! ☆ Oh, what exquisite color and luster...!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Whoa, this is irresistible☆ All roads really do lead to the acupuncture needle, don't they!
choice_data_list: What does takoyaki have to do with acupuncture……?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Administering treatments and delicately grilling meat are (probably) quite similar.
Which means I can hone my skills while working a part-time job!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Dodging splattering oil,
stabbing and flipping takoyaki day after day...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: The me who burned it to a crisp and got chewed out by the store manager is officially history...!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Now then, behold the fruits of my training and bon appétit☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I took the piping hot takoyaki
and popped one into my mouth... The springy
batter and juicy octopus danced across my palate!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, what a great look on your face.
It was worth turning them with my personal needle.
...Ah, for takoyaki, of course.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Let's pump these out at full blast at this pace~!
Whoa, mass production~â

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What splendid needlework. Her technique... might actually be trustworthy?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I took the piping hot takoyaki
and popped one into my mouth, but... no chew.
...Looks like there's no octopus inside.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Huh, no way... Then does that mean everything on the grill right now is...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Sasami Anshinzawa received
a severe scolding from the store manager...
